displayName: Suspicious Node.js or Python Developer Runtime Spawning Obfuscated Shell

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe", "node", "npm", "npx", "python.exe", "python3")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cmd.exe", "sh", "bash", "curl", "wget")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc", "base64", "eval(", "curl ", "wget ", "http://", "https://")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("| sh", "| bash", "iex", "invoke-expression", "-enc", "base64")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Suspicious Node.js or Python Developer Runtime Spawning Obfuscated Shell
alertTemplate.description: Detects Node.js, npm or Python developer runtimes executing remote download or encoded shell commands, matching WaterPlum (Contagious Interview) tradecraft targeting IT staff. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-0843, ISM-1405, ISM-1621. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-22-north-korean-waterplum-contagious-interview.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Inspect the parent npm package or Python script on the developer workstation, check for untrusted cloned repositories, and rotate developer SSH keys and cloud tokens (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-0843, ISM-1405, ISM-1621; Advisories: acsc-2026-09-22-north-korean-waterplum-contagious-interview).
